CYB-101

As an undergraduate in the Cybersecurity program I learnt the appropriate tools, techniques, policies, and technologies required to identify, analyze, mitigate, and communicate the risks of computer systems. I worked in Powershell and Bash using the Ubuntu virtual machine. Final project was a forensics lab where the goal was to find 'interesting files' and identify the type of malware associated with each.

CS-101 & CS-131

As an undergraduate Computer Science 101 major I prepared for entry-level software engineering, networking, database application development, and web administration.

Computer Science 131 Progamming lab taught the basic fundamentals of coding in Java, creating arrays sorting, searching and object oriented programming (OOP) inheriting classes, functions and methods.
